assumptions.surface: Surface fire only: canopy inputs zero, no crown fire, spotting or suppression.
assumptions.fuels: EFFIS European fuel map (ver. 2017) crosswalked to Anderson/NFFL models; generalized and coarse (about 290 m), not field-measured.
assumptions.exclusions: Unclassified fuel, WorldCover built-up/bare/water and missing terrain act as barriers; they are not all measured nonburnable.
assumptions.wind: One wind value over the whole area, at 10 m, held for each hour; no gusts, terrain channelling or valley winds.
assumptions.dryness: What-if dryness uses the Scott & Burgan (2005) moisture scenarios. Real days derive dead fuel moisture from hourly temperature and humidity (Simard 1968 equilibrium moisture, NFDRS rules); live moisture is assumed (L2).
assumptions.edge: Runs stop being shown when the modeled fire reaches the edge of the mapped area.
